# Cross-cutting findings

## Registered skills with a missing script

None. Every registered skill resolves to a script on disk.

## The registration gap

1 of 2 agent-readable skills ship a Python script but have no entry in the `SKILLS` dict in `clawbio/cli.py`, so they cannot be reached through `clawbio run`.

That is 33% of all listed skills.

Without a Python script (1): `gamma`.

## Coverage asymmetry

Fully runnable domains: Analysis.

Domains with no CLI path at all: Quality, Uncategorised.
